snippet.title: How to Play Longball in 2 Minutes | Go Long!
snippet.description:
Throw, catch, dive and score: every Longball rule in two minutes, from Long Bombs to halftime bosses.

👉 Wishlist Go Long! on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5356650/

Go Long! is a goofy, floppy 3v3 catching sport. Throw Long Bombs, dive for trick catches, mess with rivals using powers in six wild stadiums, then pelt a giant boss at halftime. Coming soon to Steam.

0:00 The basics
0:21 Scoring
0:37 Oops: free points
0:55 Heat
1:14 Powers
1:33 Halftime boss
1:47 Sudden death
